failedRegressions: already decoded Media reveals immediately without a second decode or frame
Media owns decoding while loading and the gate waits for its committed ready state
broken managed images wait for their alternate or terminal fallback
a changed managed source loses its ready state until the new decode commits
an unmanaged srcset selection still requires the replacement decode
